name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard matches "the very next move must pick it up again", and Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard matches "if you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box". at_exit holds only on the last step, so the Response requires holding_box on that step. Both are conditional rules, so the rule-only warning is valid and no Existence clause is needed.

texts: If the box falls, the very next step must pick it up again, so holding_box is true on the step right after box_fell.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be carrying the box at that moment.
